title: psychotria berizokae
intro: Psychotria berizokae, commonly known as the Berizoka vine, is a species of flowering plant in the family Rubiaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Psychotria berizokae include wound healing, antispasmodic, and anticonvulsant activities, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids. However, detailed information on the bioactive constituents is limited and requires further research.
